summary: Completed public API regression and desktop/mobile end-to-end testing for story creation, viewer paging, checkout, dashboard, and admin order updates.
action_items: Pass the selected story ID and child name into checkout instead of the hardcoded story_id=latest and child_name=Maya values.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout submits hardcoded story_id 'latest' and child_name 'Maya', so orders made from other storybooks are associated with incorrect metadata.
API and UI requests have no catch/error state; network or MongoDB failures can leave create, storybook, dashboard, admin, or checkout screens blank/loading without user feedback.
Admin order status accepts arbitrary strings; validate allowed workflow statuses server-side.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Riley story and TEST Buyer order through public APIs; UI run created UI Riley story/order. Data remains in demo database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core public flows pass on desktop and 390px mobile. Re-test checkout association after routing story context into checkout; external AI/payment are intentionally MOCKED.
rca of the issue: Checkout component posts fixed story_id='latest' and child_name='Maya' regardless of the originating Storybook route. This is a data-integrity issue rather than a UI failure; carry story identity through the Order Physical Book link and submit payload. AI generation and payment processing are MOCKED by design.
